description: Build a GlobalHostia cart link to transfer a domain from another registrar to GlobalHostia, with the transfer price when shown (usually includes one year of renewal). The customer unlocks the domain and gets its transfer code at the current registrar, then enters the code and pays on globalhostia.com; this tool never takes payment. No sign-in needed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code such as USD or AED (default USD).

domain.description: The domain to move to GlobalHostia, e.g. mybrand.com

name: transfer_in_link
title: Get a domain transfer link
